title: Optical components and colored cables on a perforated table
visual_facts: A black perforated optical table holds several compact cylindrical and rectangular devices on adjustable mounts.
A yellow rectangular module with a warning label sits near the upper center.
Blue, red, white, and tan cables run between components and across the table.
A transparent protective cover is visible along the top and right edges.
spatial_relations: The yellow module is near the center, with mounted components placed to its left, right, and lower side.
Colored cables connect or pass between devices across the tabletop.
uncertainties: Labels are too small to read, so the optical setup and component functions cannot be identified.
